lessons.summary: SAMPLE. Authority asks who is allowed to make or apply a rule.
checklist: SAMPLE. I can say who holds this power.

sections.heading: SAMPLE. The question
sections.body: SAMPLE. Authority is about who the law lets act, not about who is strongest.

questions.prompt: SAMPLE. Authority asks who is allowed to make a rule.
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. Authority is the question of who holds legal power. Strength alone does not create it.

questions.prompt: SAMPLE. Which question does Authority ask?
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. Authority is about who holds legal power, not about harm or remedy.

pairs.definition: What the law does about a breach

questions.prompt: SAMPLE. Authority asks who has legal ____.
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. The blank is power: who the law permits to act.

games.prompt: SAMPLE. Place the term for who may make a rule.
games.explanation: SAMPLE. Authority names who may make the rule. Remedy names what follows a breach.
SAMPLE. Legal power belongs to the body the rule names, not to the stronger party.

games.prompt: SAMPLE. A town hearing about who may close the square.
games.explanation: SAMPLE. The charter names the council, so a witness who names the loudest resident is contradicted.

testimony.speaker: Witness
testimony.text: SAMPLE. I was in the square when the rope went up.

testimony.speaker: Witness
testimony.text: SAMPLE. The loudest resident may close the square whenever they wish.
testimony.contradiction: SAMPLE. Charter excerpt: only the town council may close the square.

evidence.label: Charter excerpt
evidence.text: SAMPLE. Only the town council may close the square.

evidence.label: Festival poster
evidence.text: SAMPLE. The square hosts a market on Saturdays.

lessons.summary: SAMPLE. A harder pass on the same idea: authority can be limited by the grant that created it.

questions.prompt: SAMPLE. A council closes the square for a private party. The charter lets it close the square only for safety. What is the best challenge?
options: The act is outside the grant of authority
A poster is not a document
Safety is a kind of remedy
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. Authority includes its limit. An act outside the grant is the challenge, even if the body is the right one.

games.prompt: SAMPLE. Place the phrase for an act outside the grant.
games.explanation: SAMPLE. Ultra vires means beyond the powers granted. It is not a remedy, a harm, or a notice.

games.prompt: SAMPLE. Which limit travels with authority?
games.correct: The grant that created the power
games.explanation: SAMPLE. The grant both gives the power and marks where it stops.

questions.prompt: SAMPLE. A right, in this course, is best described as:
options: Protection the law gives a person
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. Rights are protections the law recognizes, not prizes or stamps.

options: How long a speech may be
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. Duty is about who is obligated to act or to hold back.

options: Whether this forum may hear the matter
The price of a filing stamp
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. Jurisdiction is about the forum's power to hear the matter.

questions.prompt: SAMPLE. Pleading is the step where parties:
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. Pleadings put claims and defenses on the record.

questions.prompt: SAMPLE. The burden of proof answers:
options: How many pages a brief has
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. The burden of proof assigns who has to prove the point.

questions.prompt: SAMPLE. An authority-defining case is studied because it:
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. These cases are landmarks about who holds a legal power.

questions.prompt: SAMPLE. The debate of individual versus state power weighs:
options: A person's liberty against public power
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. This debate is about liberty on one side and public power on the other.

options: Finding the legal questions in a set of facts
questions.explanation: SAMPLE. Issue spotting pulls the legal questions out of the facts.
